node.title: EF pole-free hidden-cycle exclusion
node.statement: No B-defined horizontal cycle in the extension-fiber pole complement, after removing base-descended and proper-subfield pullback components and imposing noncontainment, can survive as an unpaid full-field hidden-fiber leakage class. This is reduced to classification-certificate soundness plus the remaining descended-cycle classification payload.
node.attack_surface: assembly from proved descended-cycle classification soundness and the remaining EF geometric classification payload
node.falsifier: a B-defined pole-free horizontal cycle in the extension-fiber incidence that is not base-descended, not tower-confined, survives noncontainment, or exposes a defect in the classification soundness rule
